description: Claims that were withdrawn or refuted after verification. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py fails any pull request that adds a line repeating one of them. A line is allowed when it cites the claim as withdrawn or corrected (see allow_line_markers), or sits on a verbatim or archive path (see allow_paths). Each claim carries must_match and must_not_match. The script refuses to run when a pattern misses a must_match form or matches a must_not_match correction. Add a claim here the day it is withdrawn, with both lists.
mirror_of: cogpy/ad-res-j7 docs/strategic/WITHDRAWN_CLAIMS_REGISTER.json (2026-11-03). ad-res-j7 is canonical: add claims there first, then copy.

must_not_match: Prime Product Manufacturing is SLG's manufacturing source.
claims.correction: RST (RegimA Skin Treatments CC) has never manufactured. Strategic Logistics CC (SLG) is the manufacturing principal: it orders from and pays the contract manufacturer Prime Product Manufacturing (the bank shows SLG R40.4m against RST R20.3m, RST's last PPM payment in 2018), buys R23.9m of the R27.0m of raw materials and packaging, claims the input VAT, is named consignor on every customs record, and DR H's own books name it supplier 2017-2020. RST buys finished stock from SLG. The label began as the heading 'RST (Manufacturing Hub)' over an October 2025 analysis of the group's own trial balances (rzonedevops/analysis 6195a97), whose tables put the manufacture-cost accounts under SLG.
claims.source: case owner, 2026-10-21; fincosys/fincosys-core reports/parties/SLG_RST_ATTRIBUTION.md (§2a lineage) and reports/parties/SLG_RST_ATTRIBUTION_TIMELINE.md
